metadata.title: High-Contrast Urban Portrait with Halo Effect

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait featuring a central subject emerging from total darkness with a soft red glow behind the head.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up portrait of a man against a solid black background. The subject's face and hands are illuminated with high-contrast lighting, while his clothing blends into the darkness. A soft, circular red glow emanates from behind his head, creating a modern halo effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Red halo provides the only color contrast against monochrome skin tones
Bright jewelry and cup rim act as secondary focal points
Deep shadows obscure the torso to create a floating effect
coreInvariants: Soft-edged red circular glow behind the head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, framed by the red halo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face/halo, move down the jewelry to the hand holding the cup at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject on all sides.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Desaturated skin tones and silver jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between skin/jewelry and background; low saturation except for the red accents.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man with a fade haircut and silver chains against a pure black background. Apply a soft red radial glow behind his head. Ensure his black shirt blends perfectly into the background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a bold, wide sans-serif font in white, placed either at the very top or very bottom to maintain the central focus.

verificationChecks: Is there a soft red glow behind the head?
Is the lighting high-contrast on the face?

mustRedesign: Avoid any visible background elements or textures other than grain
Ensure the clothing is indistinguishable from the black background

mustAchieve: Smooth gradient for the red halo

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black levels in the background
Verify the red halo is centered behind the head
Confirm the cup at the bottom is visible but secondary
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key lighting + centered subject + red radial head-glow + black-on-black styling.
